messages:
anya: FYI we saw a short burst of hallucinations on int4-canary for long-context summaries. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/q/long-halluc
raj: baseline ~0.2% -> burst ~1.8% for ~18m, concentrated on seqlen>1500. samples in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/int4-burst
oliver: could be kv-cache index wrap or kernel offset bug in quant path. any token corruption observed?
eva: yes, a few outputs show off-by-one token repetition before the hallucination sentence. matches previous kv-get misalign issues.
anya: current pilot auto-fallback is disabled. proposal: enable targeted auto-fallback for route tag `route:longform` with conservative hysteresis: trigger when hallucination delta >= +1.0pp over 5m sustained for 3 windows. action: route to float16 replica.
raj: propose rollout: update canary-rule to filter `route:longform`, shadow 30m then 5% cut for 1h if stable. I'll also add a heavy-tail smoke-eval (N=80, seqlen 1k-3k).
oliver: i'll own rollback steps: flip traffic to float16, set int4 `kv_cache.disable=true`, collect diffs, run postmortem.
ci-bot: queued smoke-eval job 85201. ETA 10m.
anya: good. monitor and reconvene after results.
